title: CPU Throttling — HPA Not Scaling Fast Enough
symptom: CPU throttling >80% on pods; HPA at max replica count but p99 latency still degraded; requests queuing in load balancer; 504 Gateway Timeout errors appearing.
remediation_steps: Check HPA status: kubectl get hpa -n <namespace>
Check current CPU throttling: kubectl top pods -n <namespace>
Temporarily raise maxReplicas: kubectl patch hpa <hpa-name> -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":20}}'
Reduce CPU request to allow more scheduling: kubectl set resources deployment/<name> --requests=cpu=100m
Review VPA recommendations: kubectl describe vpa <vpa-name> -n <namespace>
